died.name: Frantisek Kotzwara
died.cause: While in London, the 61-year-old Czech violinist visited a prostitute named Susannah Hill and requested his neck be tied with a noose around a door knob. He died after the sexual intercourse of erotic asphyxiation.

died.name: Richard Annesley West
died.desc: VC DSO1 MC, British Army officer
died.cause: killed in action during World War I
died.last_words: Stick it, men; show them fight, and for God's sake put up a good fight.

died.name: J. R. R. Tolkien
died.cause: postscript of letter to his daughter Priscilla
died.last_words: It is stuffy, sticky, and rainy here at present – but forecasts are more favourable.

died.name: Captain Urs Zimmermann
died.cause: as it was diverted to Halifax, Nova Scotia after declaring an emergency following electrical fire before losing control and rapid descent
died.last_words: And we are declaring emergency now, Swissair one eleven!

born.name: John Howard
born.cause: dying of typhus contracted on a prison visit in Kherson
born.last_words: Suffer no pomp at my funeral, nor monumental inscription where I am laid. Lay me quietly in the earth and put a sun-dial over my grave, and let me be forgotten.

born.name: Johann Georg Jacobi
born.cause: referring to a poem for New Year's Day that he had completed on New Year's Eve; he in fact lived 5 more days
born.last_words: I shall not in fact see the new year which I have just commemorated.

born.name: Lewis Benedict
born.desc: American politician and Union colonel of the American Civil War
born.cause: before being killed at the Battle of Pleasant Hill
born.last_words: Colonel, rally your men and advance as soon as possible.

born.name: An Jung-geun
born.desc: Korean independence fighter and assassin of Ito Hirobumi
born.last_words: When the day comes that I hear of Korea's independence in heaven, I will dance and shout 'Hurrah!'

born.name: Christina Marie Riggs
born.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection for killing her two young children
born.last_words: There is no way words can express how sorry I am for taking the lives of my babies. Now I can be with my babies, as I always intended. I love you my babies.
